editions.credit: Against Eunomius (Books I–XII) with the Answer to Eunomius' Second Book, in A Select Library of Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers of the Christian Church, Second Series, vol. V: Gregory of Nyssa, Dogmatic Treatises; Select Writings and Letters (American edition; ed. Philip Schaff and Henry Wace), trans. William Moore and Henry Austin Wilson (the title page names both; it does not say which of them translated each treatise) (New York: The Christian Literature Company, 1893). Wikisource contributors, English Wikisource (Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series II), CC BY-SA 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0).
